content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor - Skill at a Glance
About NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor - Skill
content_sections.text: The National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) Karnataka, under Sanjeevini – KSRLPS, aims to uplift rural communities through targeted skill development and placement initiatives. The Cluster Supervisor - Skill position plays a critical role in pre-mobilization, village-level data collection, awareness creation, and tracking placed candidates under programs like DDU-GKY.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor - Skill Job Description
content_sections.text: Pre Mobilization: Information dissemination in villages. Block/GP wise data collection and maintenance of skill register and entering the same in Kaushal Panjee. Awareness creation in rural community through mass media. Block/GP wise mobilization target setting in discussion with state nodal department. Mobilization: Coordination with PIAs about the district target sanctioned, details of training centre, course, job role, mobilization plan of PIAs etc. Preparation of monthly mobilization calendar for organizing mobilization camps in Block/GPs. Meeting with Blocks (involving PIAs) to make them aware about the Block/GP wise mobilization plan and other training details. Installation of boards informing about program, eligibility criteria, opportunities, candidate entitlements, mobilization camps schedule at District, block and GP office. Block/GP level awareness creation through meetings, door to door campaign – Providing program related information, eligibility criteria, opportunities, candidate entitlements, PIA wise details of training centre, courses, job role etc. Organizing mass mobilization camps at Block and GP level. To ensure participation of candidates and parents at scheduled mobilization camp. Counseling and Selection of Candidates: Presentation about training course, job role, opportunities etc. at the mobilization camp by PIAs. One-to-one counseling of candidates and parents by PIAs. Aptitude assessment and selection of candidates by PIAs. Reporting of non-selected candidates to Block and District Offices to arrange further camps. Preparation of candidate wait-list for village. Pre – Training: Sharing the details of selected candidates with Block/Districts along with training start date. To provide necessary information to candidates regarding training start date and travel arrangements (for residential courses). Making travel arrangements for candidates to join the training program (for residential courses) by PIAs. Training: Visit of community cadre and parents to training centers with District and Block functionaries. Coordination with PIAs in case of any difficulties faced by candidate. Reporting of dropout candidates with their dropout reason to DMMU, BPM. Counseling of dropout candidates for re-joining the program. Post Placement: Obtaining candidate placement details from PIAs. Reporting of candidate placement details to community cadres. Reporting of candidate placement details to parents. To keep the placement details of candidates. To keep the placement details and contact details of the employers. Tracking of placed candidates especially female candidates as per the provision of Guidelines. Uploading of tracking details in the designated web-link. Sharing the information with Govt. functionaries as per the need. Additional tracking of candidates directly or through the family members.
